objective: Test whether the failed 1Min direct-direction lane becomes economically useful when the target is normalized future point move and the model role is expected-move regression rather than three-class direction classification.
timestamp_contract: Raw Last.csv timestamps are America/New_York right-close labels; normalize DST-aware to UTC bar start by subtracting one minute after UTC conversion. Use this corrected contract from the first row of all training and evaluation.

expected_move_policy.target: future MNQ point move divided by current close * rv_120 * sqrt(horizon)
expected_move_policy.signal: sign(predicted normalized move) only when abs(prediction) clears the 50th percentile of absolute prediction magnitude learned from four chronological inner OOF folds on prior data only
expected_move_policy.tuning: No alpha, feature, horizon, OOF quantile, cost, phase, week, year, or threshold selection from discovery outcomes.

direct_classifier_control.purpose: Regenerate the failed model role under the corrected timestamp source rather than compare against the older timestamp interpretation.
direct_classifier_control.model: StandardScaler + class-balanced multinomial SGDClassifier(log_loss, fixed random_state)
direct_classifier_control.target: three-class direction/dead-zone target using the predeclared config volatility multiplier

chronology.discovery: Quarterly expanding walk-forward from 2023Q3 through 2025Q4 with full horizon purge for each config.
chronology.phase_rule: Use every absolute-UTC one-minute slot modulo horizon as a non-overlapping phase stream. Report every phase; select none post-hoc.
chronology.forward: If and only if discovery passes, freeze the unchanged policy and run a separate corrected 2026 confirmation.

required_metrics: weekly median and mean phase net points
paired expected-move minus direct-classifier weekly delta
cumulative weekly statistic and max drawdown

discovery_advance_rule: For both H30 and H60 separately, at both 1pt and 2pt require >=80 paired valid weeks; expected-move median and mean net points >0; expected-move positive-week fraction >0.50; paired expected-move-minus-direct-classifier median >0, mean >0 and win fraction >0.50; expected-move p10 and bottom-decile mean no worse than direct classifier; expected-move max drawdown no worse than direct classifier. A horizon passes only if all checks pass. At least one horizon must pass unchanged to earn separate corrected-2026 confirmation; no post-hoc blend or horizon selection is allowed beyond reporting the predeclared pass/fail of each config.
nq_boundary: NQ is excluded from model inputs and threshold fitting. It remains later independent/pre-MNQ validation only after an unchanged MNQ mechanism survives discovery and corrected 2026 confirmation.
